description: Grammars whose rules use feature union expressions (alias, precedence, a Unicode class, a call of a parameterized rule): the merge compares each by its native listing over equivalent references. js/tests/grammar-merge.test.js and rust/tests/unit/grammar_merge.rs both check these decisions.

sources.text:
start document
rule document = normal repeat0(alias(item, ref(number)))
rule number = token class(category("Nd"), char("_"))
rule sum = normal precedence(2, left, seq(ref(number), literal("+"), ref(number)))
rule call = normal ref(list, ref(number))
rule list(element) = normal repeat1(ref(element))

start file
rule file = normal repeat0(alias(item, ref(digits)))
rule digits = token class(category("Nd"), char("_"))
rule sum = normal precedence(3, left, seq(ref(digits), literal("+"), ref(digits)))
